name: 8W8
description: TR-808 style drum machine - 16 circuit-modelled voices, no samples. Velocity-played, 7 distortion types per voice and on the master, reverb and delay sends, bus compressor.
author: athousanddetails; voices transcribed from sc808 (Yoshinosuke Horiuchi / Sam Aaron, Sonic Pi)
